subject: Security & procurement kickoff — evidence checklist for PO setup
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security & procurement kickoff — evidence checklist for PO setup

Hi Anna / Kestrel team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference. To keep procurement moving and to get the PO issued quickly, Finance and Procurement need a short evidence bundle we typically require before final contract routing:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- ISO 27001 certificate (if held)
- External penetration test summary or letter from your pen test vendor
- Legal entity name + W9 / tax ID (US) or equivalent
- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached our one-page template)

Could you confirm which of these you can provide by end of week? If you can share the SOC 2 and pen test summary now, Finance will start the PO setup in parallel. If there are any NDAs needed for the SOC report, tell me and we’ll route one immediately.

Next steps on our side: I’ll assign the PO request to Marissa in finance once we have the legal name and tax ID. Laura — looping you for procurement review on any specific terms to flag.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_template_short.docx (1 page)

- SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted where required)
- ISO27001_Cert_2024.pdf
- PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf (executive summary; full report requires our legal approval)

Legal entity for PO: Kestrel Health, Inc.
EIN: 12-3456789
Billing address: 880 Wellness Ave, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02115

Two quick Qs:
1) For the pen test — is the summary sufficient for Redwood procurement, or do you need the full technical report? We can request legal sign-off but it will add 3–5 business days.
2) For the vendor onboarding form, we filled your template and attached it as Kestrel_onboarding_short.docx.

Happy to hop on a 15m call if you want to walk through anything.

Best,
Anna Kovacs

anna.kovacs@kestrelhealth.com

Karthik / Marissa —

Received Anna’s package and opened the attachments. A few items for Finance/legal to note before PO:
- SOC 2 looks current; we should request the bridge letter for controls since the report is from Q4 2025.
- Pen test exec summary is OK for initial PO routing; request full report only if we need a deeper technical review (we can flag in the purchase order notes).
- Confirming legal entity and EIN above — good to go for PO line item setup.

Marissa: please start the PO draft using Kestrel Health, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789). Add a clause to require delivery of the full pen test report to our security team within 30 days of contract signature if they opt to withhold the full report now.

Karthik: can you confirm if procurement needs any special SOX or vendor classification for this account? If not, I’ll proceed with standard enterprise PO flow.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Desai <samir.desai@kestrelhealth.com>

Laura / Karthik — quick note from security: the pen test summary includes the critical findings section and remediation timelines, which is sufficient for initial commercial review. We will grant Redwood access to the full technical report under an NDA if needed.

One ask: please include a clause that backups and logs retention comply with our mutual incident response expectations — we’ll share a short SOW bullet.

Samir
